newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Ringgit little impressed with Malaysia trade data.
newsitem.headline: Ringgit little impressed with Malaysia trade data.

text.p: The ringgit extended its consolidation against the dollar, little impressed by a narrowing deficit on the Malaysian trade data, dealers said.
The currency was immediately pushed up when the data was released in the late-morning, but dollar short-covering brought it back down, they said.

"The figure came out and the market whacked down dollar/ringgit," said a dealer at a Malaysian bank. "But now, there's short-covering." The Statistics Department said 1996's trade deficit stood at 617.97 million ringgit, well below the official forecast of a 5.2 billion gap.
